evals.prompt: I want to build a TOML parser in MoonBit. It should parse TOML 1.0 files and serialize them back to TOML strings. Target platform is native only.
evals.expected_output: MoonBit project with TOML parser: plan/ (requirements + architecture), scaffold/ (skeleton), implement/ (TDD), verify/ (gate passed), evaluate/ (README + CI)

evals.prompt: Help me write a MoonBit CLI tool that counts source lines in all .mbt files recursively and excludes _build directories.
evals.expected_output: MoonBit CLI project: plan/ (CLI parameter design), scaffold/ (cli skeleton), implement/ (TDD), verify/ (gate passed), evaluate/ (README + CI)

evals.prompt: I need to wrap a C library called libfoo in MoonBit. It has about 20 functions for image processing.
evals.expected_output: MoonBit native FFI binding project: plan/ (four-layer FFI architecture), scaffold/ (c-ffi skeleton), implement/ (L0 outward bindings), verify/ (gate passed + optional ASan)

evals.prompt: I wrote a MoonBit JSON parser but it is failing on nested objects. The error is type mismatch: expected Object but got Array. Help me debug this.
evals.expected_output: Debug built into implement: collect failure info, classify, diagnose, fix, and re-verify. Ask the user after three failed attempts.

evals.prompt: I just finished implementing my MoonBit package. Check if it is ready for publishing.
evals.expected_output: verify/ gate (fmt + check + test + info + moon-audit), then evaluate/ (README.mbt.md + CI + publication checklist)

evals.prompt: Review my MoonBit HTTP server code for security issues.
evals.expected_output: verify/ runs the moon-audit pipeline, reports security findings, and applies safe automatic fixes where possible.
